definition: Wrapping each type of prompt content in its own tag, such as `<instructions>` or `<context>`, so Claude can parse a complex prompt unambiguously.
whyItMatters: Reduces misinterpretation when instructions, context, examples and variable inputs share one prompt. Use consistent, descriptive tag names.
example: Nest for hierarchy: `<documents>` holds each `<document index="1">`, with its source and content in their own tags.
